stem:
A student investigates the current in a circuit containing a cell, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The student connects two resistors of resistances *R*₁ and *R*₂ between P and Q. The ammeter measures the current *I*.

The student repeats the experiment with different resistors between P and Q.

It is suggested that *I*, *R*₁ and *R*₂ are related by the equation

*E* = *I*(*R*₁ + *R*₂ + *r*)

where *E* is the electromotive force (e.m.f.) and *r* is the internal resistance of the cell.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A graph is plotted $[0m\frac{1}{I}$ on the *y*-axis against (*R*₁ + *R*₂) on the *x*-axis.

Determine expressions for the gradient and *y*-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *R*₁, *R*₂ and *I* are given in Table 2.1.

Each resistance value has a percentage uncertainty of ±5%.

[[fig:f2]]

Calculate and record values of (*R*₁ + *R*₂)/Ω and $[0m\frac{1}{I}$/A⁻¹ in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in (*R*₁ + *R*₂).

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Plot a graph of $[0m\frac{1}{I}$/A⁻¹ against (*R*₁ + *R*₂)/Ω.

Include error bars for (*R*₁ + *R*₂).

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Both lines should be clearly labelled.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

[[fig:f3]]

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the *y*-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine values of *E* and *r*. Include appropriate units.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated using the same cell. The value of *R*₁ is 22 Ω. Determine the resistance *R*₂ that would give a current of 7.5 mA.

figures.caption: Fig. 2.1
figures.alt: A circuit diagram showing an ammeter, a cell with e.m.f. E and internal resistance r, and two resistors R₁ and R₂ connected between points P and Q.

figures.caption: Table 2.1
figures.alt: A table with columns for R₁/Ω, R₂/Ω, (R₁ + R₂)/Ω, I/mA and 1/I in A⁻¹, containing six rows of given resistance and current values and blank cells to be completed.
A blank square graph grid with the vertical axis labelled 1/I in A⁻¹ from 55 to 110 and the horizontal axis labelled (R₁ + R₂)/Ω from 50 to 120.
